CHEM 264.title: Computational Materials
CHEM 264.desc: Introduction of quantum mechanical simulations of materials at the atomistic level. (Formerly AMS 206.)

STAT 221.title: Statistical Machine Learning
STAT 221.desc: Explores statistical methods in machine learning. Discusses the methodology and algorithms behind modern supervised and unsupervised learning techniques that are commonly applied to complex, high dimensional problems. Course topics include linear and logistic regression, classification, clustering, resampling methods, model selection and regularization, and non-linear regression. Students also gain exposure to popular statistical machine learning algorithms implemented in R. One focus is on understanding the formulation of statistical models and their implementation, and the practical application of learning methods to real-world datasets.
